title: test_land_e2e.py's session-scoped real_git fixture leaves its PATH change in place for later test files on the same worker
goal: The real Command Line Tools git that test_land_e2e.py puts first on PATH applies to that file's tests only: the fixture is module-scoped, so a later file on the same xdist worker runs with the PATH it started with

run: import re,sys;t=open('_tools/test_land_e2e.py').read();sys.exit(1 if re.search(r'scope=.session., autouse=True\)\s*\ndef real_git',t) else 0)

repro_reason: the PATH leak shows only in which git a later module's subprocess resolves on a darwin host with the shim; the fixture's scope in the source is what decides it
